<div class="review-text">
A cute and fun way to define logical fallacies. An Illustrated Book of Bad Arguments Takes on a kind of overbearing tone at times, though, and fails to provide all of the necessary context and background which is important to understand what these logical flaws can mean for social issues and communities at large. Furthermore, despite its theme, this book is not accessible for young children. Although the book is good, the visuals do not contribute well to the overall understanding of the concepts being presented often times, which can be very misleading and make it a little bit harder to understand the terms which are being defined. Still, this is as good an introduction as any to learning about argumentative nomenclature.
</div>
